description: Engineering registry of ALL known authorization-related implementation sites. This file is NOT part of Gamma, L-DREA, FULL_SPEC, or any scientific artifact and defines no authorization logic. It is consumed only by tools/check_single_engine.py (a local, warn-only guardrail). 'exempt: true' suppresses guardrail warnings for a legitimate site: the single frozen engine, its reuse callers, replay verification, or a documented separate layer. 'exempt: false' entries are known pending sites that SHOULD continue to warn until their migration commit resolves them. Updating this registry after Commits 1.1 / 3.1 / 5.2 requires NO change to the scanner implementation.
